scope: Isolated unchanged CRT Adjust and VHDL adapter with corrected VBlank tags: 288 visible/432 total pixels at /7 enable. Each listed case records visible and total rows; the DUT uses its production 256-line generic. Exact source-pixel order, row boundaries, sync periods and bounded sync-width quantization are checked after warm-up. Non-full-height suite also checks position, size and exact +/-1-line vertical phase changes. No extreme-size clipping, setting-change or physical CRT proof; disconnected from production.
